chain.note: The two plans have the same tree, step for step. Both reach the main theorem by the paper's route: bank-exchange network, labels with L<N/2, s<Wm, tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the interchange and layer recurrences, transforms, resampling, exact recovery and the cost table. So neither chain is more complete or faithful.

overall.reason: Plan A and Plan B are textually identical except for their title line, so every item, the chain and the error set are the same in both. A check of their steps against the paper's derivation lines found no misstatement in either. No concrete difference exists to support a preference.
